loop_playback: Play all eight cells left to right and repeat only rows marked loop. Lightning flicker, ground ice, air sphere, and traveling tornado use five-pose forward-and-return cycles; the water stream advances right 16px per frame over a 128px period. Other loops use all eight generated phases.

The rock stays at horizontal center64, not moving sideways. It is a raised projectile, not a spike still attached to ground. Ground dust must not rise with the rock. Correct the second row TRAVEL into a PERIODIC ground eruption cycle. EVERY frame must contain a tall pillar about70 pixels tall plus medium and low pillars, all touching ground at y120. Animate THREE staggered pillars in a traveling sequence toward the RIGHT: left pillar rises then crumbles as center rises, then right rises while left respawns low; repeat seamlessly. At all times there are different phases (low, medium, tall), never all low and never monotonically growing larger across the entire row. Frame8 returns almost to frame1 with one small motion step. Keep base positions fixed x25,64,103 and add small flying debris. This is a traveling terrain effect, no floating rocks. Keep other rows: windup crack and lifted slab, huge central impact pillar launching then crumbling, small pebbles circling above imaginary head. All 32 cells128x128, sheet1024x512; exact grid no gutters. Effect-only, no person or hands. Everything in each cell within local x5..123 and y5..123 with transparent space between cells. validation.method: Godot 4.4 headless editor import, Texture2D load, 320 AtlasTexture regions, 40 SpriteFrames animations, AnimatedSprite2D playback initialization.
validation.loop_seam_method: Visual review plus alpha difference across the final-to-first boundary at no more than 1.2 times the largest within-loop step. Four loops use reversible phases; water stream uses exact periodic rightward translation.
validation.editor_import_notes: Headless editor printed progress-dialog message-queue errors and exited 0; subsequent runtime asset verification passed without errors.
validation.scope: Asset loading and animation resource construction in an isolated Godot 4.4 project; no integration into the game project.

integration.sampling: Nearest; disable mipmaps; standard alpha blending.
integration.playback: Use row fps and loop flags. Nonloop effects finish after eight frames.
integration.anchoring: At a ground or victim-feet position use cell anchor [64,120], equivalent to a centered 128px AnimatedSprite2D with offset [0,-56].
integration.orientation: Travel faces right. Rotate the travel effect in game as needed.
integration.source_anchor: Draw water-source and earth-rise animations at the source/ground position. The water stream is a separate horizontal repeating tile.
integration.status: Overlay only; fighter is not included. Intended character height is 64 pixels.
